answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the ridge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The atlas is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the sparrow. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
